items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Was he any kin to Joe Pian? For me?

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, they had peck horn. Old man Pian played peck horn, and Georgia Hooker played, uh, baritone. Mm-hmm.
Was he any kin to Joe Pian? For me?

No, I was in no relation to him. He just friendly, knowed me. Yeah. And, uh, I come to go with the Excelsior band for playing with old man Allen. Mm-hmm. They had three bands out one day playing the funeral. And I was playing with old man Allen that day. And they heard me playing the drum. So my cousin Peter then got me with the Excelsior.
